note: A single grass back-in site in partial shade on Short Bend Trail, a forest road off Cattaraugus Road: from PA 120 in Westport take Bitumen Road 2.4 miles, turn right on Cattaraugus Road for 1.5 miles, then right on Short Bend Trail for about 0.6 mile. No table, toilet or water. The agency cautions that it is reached by remote dirt or gravel forest roads that may not suit low-clearance vehicles or large RVs. Pack out trash. --Claude
summary: Site page re-read: CR018 still listed, Drive-In, Tent/Trailer categories (ruling 4), max vehicle 50 ft, grass back-in; count 1 and 50 ft confirmed, pull_through false added. Season year-round confirmed; Available on every night probed. Fees confirmed, $6.50 reservation fee added; hookups and facilities none. Imagery (Esri leaf-on, PASDA leaf-off): open hardwood stand with a faint two-track about 20 m north of the pin; no pad resolved, pin not moved. NHD: nothing within 200 m; not waterfront.
flags: Agency access statements (ruling 11: nothing measured): 'Caution: This campsite is accessed by remote state forest dirt or gravel roads and may not be suitable for some low-clearance vehicles or large RVs.' Grass driveway, no grade given; no Severe grade, 4WD, wet-weather or clearance statement. Kept. Boilerplate on every Sproul page, not site-specific: 'State forest roads are not maintained in the winter and often become snow covered, icy and potentially impassable' and '4WD vehicles may be recommended for some sites year-round, check notes' (this site's notes say nothing about 4WD).
Category: 'Looking For Category: Tent Site, Trailer Site' (no RV category; ruling 4: listed for trailers and long enough, stays). GIS record TrailerAccess 'Yes', NumberVehicles 1.
Pin: the stored pin matches the booking page and GIS point, but neither image shows a pad there; a faint track passes about 20 m north. Not moved, no candidate.

ATV check (ruling 1): the DCNR Sproul roadside-campsites map (05/02/2025) draws the CR-series sites as ordinary roadside campsites and shows the 'Whiskey Springs ATV Area Campsites' (WS series) as a separate inset; this site is not one of them and no agency page places it in an ATV parking lot. The Sproul advisories page does warn 'Stay Alert for ATVs on Roads' (the Northcentral Regional ATV Trail uses some forest roads). Kept.

Sproul advisories page (read 2026-11-10): no closure or restriction on this site's road; it carries the Bloody Skillet Orviston-lot section closure, the indefinite Left Branch Young Womans Creek Road closure, 'Stay Alert for ATVs on Roads', a dust advisory and a firewood-cutting road list.

NAME: the '(Cooks Run)' in the stored name is only the booking system's loop label ('Site, Loop: CR018, Cooks Run'). It is on Short Bend Trail off Cattaraugus Road, above Westport. Suggest a name that says where it is; apply.py does not write names.

Agency pages disagree on the district's own inventory: the Sproul camping page says 'Sproul State Forest offers nine roadside campsites for overnight camping in RVs. No tent camping permitted. Self-contained toilets are required.' while the district's 2025 map labels CR001-CR021 plus the WS series, and the CR booking pages list 'Tent Site, Trailer Site'. Nothing here depends on it.
